newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Bank United initiated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Bank United initiated.

text.p: -- Smith Barney initiated coverage of Bank United Corp with an outperform rating, according to the analyst, who confirmed an earlier item attributed to a market source.

-- The analyst said he likes the stock because it is a good play on the Texas economy since it is the largest independent bank in the state, has a "deeply talented" management team, and is "opportunistically making the conversion to a bank from a savings and loan.
-- Operating earnings estimate for the 1996 fiscal year ended last month is $1.75 per share and for fiscal 1997 it is $2.25 per share.
-- The analyst's 12-month price target on the stock is $28-$30 per share.
-- Shares rose 1/4 to 25 in early Nasdaq trade.
